title: 云依助手 0.13.6
releaseNotes: Adds a desktop Packet Sender with TCP/UDP, text/HEX/escaped-byte editing, binary payload loading, a local packet library and JSON import/export. Bounded repeat sends can be stopped; importing and loading never transmit automatically. Left editing and right-hand saved packets/live TX/RX logs remain independently scrollable. Supports IPv4 UDP multicast sending through the system default route with explicit local-binding consent, not multicast reception or HTTP/TLS. Includes 21 desktop tools and the packaged pink Yiyi character.
